description: This file contains functions to retrieve device properties and log system uptime, including platform-specific code for different hardware environments.

methods.name: getValueFromDeviceProperties
methods.description: Reads a property value from the device properties file based on the property name.

methods.name: print_uptime
methods.description: Logs system uptime information, either via RPC call for specific hardware or by writing to a log file, with platform-specific behavior.
